gaps.sentence: The results of the survey were highly ___ (SURPRISE).
The problem was ___ (SIMPLE) a matter of bad timing.
gaps.explanation: 'Simply a matter of' = only a matter of.

gaps.sentence: The government made a formal ___ (DECLARE) of intent to invest in rail.
gaps.explanation: 'A formal declaration' — the noun follows the adjective.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (IMPORTANT) of sleep is often ignored.

gaps.explanation: 'Her confidence' — the noun; 'confident' is the adjective.

gaps.sentence: He lost his ___ (CONFIDENT) after the failure.
She waited ___ (ANXIOUS) by the phone for news.
Rising sea levels ___ (THREAT) the very existence of the island.
gaps.explanation: A main verb is needed after the plural subject: threaten.
